entries.title: II Chronicles 20:1
segments: And it happened after this the sons of Moab, and the sons of Ammon came in, and with them [others] besides the Ammonites, to battle against Jehoshaphat.

entries.title: II Chronicles 20:2
segments: And they came in and spoke to Jehoshaphat, saying, A great multitude has come against you from beyond the sea on this side of Syria. And behold, they [are] in Hazazon-tamar, which is En-gedi.

entries.title: II Chronicles 20:3
segments: And Jehoshaphat feared and set himself to seek the LORD, and called for a fast throughout all Judah.

entries.title: II Chronicles 20:4
segments: And Judah gathered themselves to ask of the LORD. Even out of all the cities of Judah they came to seek the LORD.

entries.title: II Chronicles 20:5
segments: And Jehoshaphat stood in the congregation of Judah and Jerusalem, in the house of the LORD, before the new court,

entries.title: II Chronicles 20:6
segments: and said, O LORD God of our Fathers, [are] You not God in Heaven? And do You rule over all the kingdoms of the nations? And [is there] power and might in Your hand, so that none is able to withstand You?

entries.title: II Chronicles 20:7
segments: [Are] You not our God? Did [You] not drive out the people of this land before Israel, and give it to the seed of Your friend Abraham forever?

entries.title: II Chronicles 20:8
segments: And they lived in it. And they have built You a temple in it for Your name, saying,

entries.title: II Chronicles 20:9
segments: If evil comes on us, [whether] the sword, judgment, or plague, or famine, and we stand before this house and in Your presence (for Your name [is] in this house) and cry to You in our affliction, then You will hear and help.

entries.title: II Chronicles 20:10
segments: And now, behold, the sons of Ammon and Moab and Mount Seir, whom You would not let Israel invade when they came out of the land of Egypt, but they turned from them and did not destroy them,

entries.title: II Chronicles 20:11
segments: behold, they reward us by coming to cast us out of Your possession, which You have given us to inherit.

entries.title: II Chronicles 20:12
segments: O our God, will You not judge them? For we have no might against this great company which comes against us. Nor do we know what to do, but our eyes [are] on You.

entries.title: II Chronicles 20:13
segments: And all Judah stood before the LORD with their little ones, their wives, and their sons.

entries.title: II Chronicles 20:14
segments: And the Spirit of the LORD came on Jahaziel the son of Zechariah, the son of Benaiah, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, a Levite of the sons of Asaph, in the midst of the congregation.

entries.title: II Chronicles 20:15
segments: And he said, Listen, all Judah, and you people of Jerusalem, and king Jehoshaphat! So says the LORD to you, Do not be afraid nor dismayed because of this great multitude. For the battle [is] not yours, but God's.

entries.title: II Chronicles 20:16
segments: Tomorrow go down against them. Behold, they come up by the cliff of Ziz. And you shall find them at the end of the valley, before the wilderness of Jeruel.

entries.title: II Chronicles 20:17
segments: You shall not fight in this [battle]. Set yourselves and stand, and see the salvation of the LORD with you, O Judah and Jerusalem. Do not fear nor be dismayed. Tomorrow go out against them, for the LORD [will be] with you.

entries.title: II Chronicles 20:18
segments: And Jehoshaphat bowed his face to the ground. And all Judah and the people of Jerusalem fell before the LORD, worshiping the LORD.

entries.title: II Chronicles 20:19
segments: And the Levites, of the sons of the Kohathites and of the sons of the Korhites, stood up to praise the LORD God of Israel with a loud voice on high.

entries.title: II Chronicles 20:20
segments: And they rose early in the morning and went out into the wilderness of Tekoa. And as they went out, Jehoshaphat stood and said, Hear me, O Judah, and you people of Jerusalem. Believe in the LORD your God, and so you shall be established. Believe His prophets, and so you shall be blessed.

entries.title: II Chronicles 20:21
segments: And he consulted with the people, and he appointed singers to the LORD and praisers to praise the beauty of holiness as they went out before the army, and to say, Praise the LORD, for His mercy [endures] forever.

entries.title: II Chronicles 20:22
segments: And when they began to sing and to praise, the LORD set ambushes against the sons of Ammon, Moab, and mount Seir, who had come against Judah. And they were beaten.

entries.title: II Chronicles 20:23
segments: For the sons of Ammon and Moab stood up against the people of mount Seir to completely kill and destroy. And when they had made an end of the people of Seir, everyone helped to destroy another.

entries.title: II Chronicles 20:24
segments: And when Judah came to the watchtower in the wilderness, they looked at the multitude. And behold! They [were] dead bodies fallen to the earth, and none escaped.

entries.title: II Chronicles 20:25
segments: And Jehoshaphat and his people came to take their plunder, they found among them in abundance both riches and precious jewels in great number with the dead bodies, which they stripped off for themselves, more than they could carry away. And they were three days in gathering of the plunder, it was so much.

entries.title: II Chronicles 20:26
segments: And on the fourth day they gathered themselves in the Valley of Blessing. For there they blessed the LORD. And the name of the same place was called the Valley of Blessing until this day.

entries.title: II Chronicles 20:27
segments: And they returned, every man of Judah and Jerusalem, and Jehoshaphat in front of them, to go again to Jerusalem with joy. For the LORD had made them to rejoice over their enemies.

entries.title: II Chronicles 20:28
segments: And they came into Jerusalem with harps and with lyres, and with trumpets to the house of the LORD.

entries.title: II Chronicles 20:29
segments: And the fear of God was on all the kingdoms of [those] countries, when they had heard that the LORD fought against the enemies of Israel.

entries.title: II Chronicles 20:30
segments: And the kingdom of Jehoshaphat was quiet. For his God gave him rest round about.

entries.title: II Chronicles 20:31
segments: And Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah, thirty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty-five years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name [was] Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.

entries.title: II Chronicles 20:32
segments: And he walked in the way of Asa his father, and did not depart from it, doing the right in the sight of the LORD.

entries.title: II Chronicles 20:33
segments: But, the high places were not taken away, for as yet the people had not prepared their hearts to the God of their fathers.

entries.title: II Chronicles 20:34
segments: And the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, first and last, behold, they [are] written in the book of Jehu the son of Hanani, which [were] taken up in the /Book of the Kings of Israel.

entries.title: II Chronicles 20:35
segments: And after this Jehoshaphat king of Judah joined himself with Ahaziah king of Israel; he did wickedly to do so.

entries.title: II Chronicles 20:36
segments: And he joined himself with him to make ships to go to Tarshish. And they made the ships in Ezion-geber.

entries.title: II Chronicles 20:37
segments: And Eliezer the son of Dodavah of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, Because you have joined yourself with Ahaziah, the LORD has broken your works. And the ships were broken so that they were not able to go to Tarshish.
